title: Orbital Observation and Robotic Surface Interaction Strategy for 433 Eros: A Theoretical Feasibility Study
abstract: This preprint presents a theoretical feasibility study of a dual-mode mission architecture for near-Earth asteroid 433 Eros, combining low-altitude science orbit with robotic surface anchoring. We analyze orbital stability under perturbations, evaluate delta-v requirements, and model regolith penetration, concluding that a controlled frozen orbit with surface anchoring is theoretically viable.

title: The Quantum Ontology of Light: A Critical Review
abstract: This comprehensive review resolves the wave-particle duality of light within quantum electrodynamics, presenting the photon as an excitation of the quantized electromagnetic field. We provide a complete synthesis of light's quantum ontology, including simulations of key quantum optics phenomena.

title: Mapping the Global Academic Funnel: A Data-Driven Analysis of Student Progression, Attrition, and Associated Costs
abstract: This study presents a data-driven model of the global academic funnel, tracking 1,000 students from secondary education to academic scientist. We find extreme attrition (0.7% survival) and quantify costs, highlighting systemic inefficiencies and inequality.
